newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Stet bids 8.4 bln ATS for Mobilkom Austria stake.
newsitem.headline: Stet bids 8.4 bln ATS for Mobilkom Austria stake.

text.p: Austrian postal and telecoms monopoly PTA said on Wednesday Italy's Stet had offered 8.4 billion schillings ($697.2 million) for a 25 percent stake in Mobilkom Austria, the country's biggest mobile phone network.
Stet has made an offer totalling 8.4 billion schillings," PTA chief executive Josef Sindelka told a news briefing. ($ = 12.04 Austrian Schillings)
The deal is subject to regulatory clearance by the European Commission, PTA said earlier on Wednesday.
Stet outbid rival offers from Tele Danmark, the Unicom unit of the international Unisource alliance, and South Western Bell of the U.S.
